/repos/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/relea.body:
## What's Changed
* review: Log why GitHub refused a review submission by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1288
* secure-host: Retire the second user, secure-host/internal and sandbox exec by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1293
* prepare: Let the agent job give a named inference broker its tailnet address by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1323
* session: Have an agent stuck on one tool call hand back by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1329
* session: Retry a rate-limited task turn before asking for a hand-back by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1340
* release: Prepare 0.6.3 by @cgwalters-bot in https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/pull/1345


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cgwalters-forge/agentic-job/compare/v0.6.2...v0.6.3

items.title: ci: Bump actions/deploy-pages to 5.0.1
secure-host: Refuse the removed sandbox-user input again

docs: Leave the host's hardening to secure-host's docs and keep only the agent's use
run: Make the runner's user the default agent user, with the sandbox user one input away
sandbox setup: Keep the sandbox user by default, opt out with sandbox.create-user = false
docs: Bring the gh-aw comparison up to date, gh-cao included
agent job: Let a caller opt the agent into the egress write policy
config: Read the example and verifier repository from configuration, not code
config: Turn on the runner's metadata, reads and Worker-diagnostics rules by default under the lock
secure-host: Pin the forwarder and site.yml to actions with the v0.6.3 image
status: Let the caller name the comment the run's status goes in
site: Show the LLM notice as a page banner instead of a body blockquote
run: Make run's token probes the only ones, with the documented ids
workflows check: Advise only the hardening input the checker admits, and make the caller example pass it
workflow: Say that activate, notify, apply and conclude hold id-token
docs: Describe secure-host's lock and metadata rule as config keys, not removed inputs
docs: Start every generated document with the LLM notice
handback: Refuse a new run token in the in-session scan
run: Refuse [child-agent] under --runner-home
docs: Describe the runner-user agent the reusable workflow actually runs
docs, dispatch: Say the reusable workflow refuses keys, MCP, private targets and setup.tools; refuse api-key in dispatch preflig
site: Give the docs site a landing page that explains agentic-job at a glance
workflows check: Admit a deploy-only Pages job without secure-host
run: Drop a hand-back whose requests file is not taken, and say so
inference: Cut the key out of a provider's whole answer before shortening it
apply: Escape what the handlers log, so the agent's patch cannot form a workflow command
policy: Refuse GitHub by host name, not by whole authority
run: Redact the reason a change was dropped before it is shown
sandbox: Refuse the sandbox user the IPv6 metadata address unconditionally
apply: Keep carriage returns when the Forgejo publisher applies a patch
policy: Apply the per-output pins to add_reviewer and assign_to_user too
review: Check dependency manifest and lockfile changes as supply chain
docs: Publish the docs as a Starlight site on GitHub Pages
docs: Name the code owner for the merge policy and say who must add CODEOWNERS

ci: Fail the scratch cleanup only on a real leak, not on a transient API error
apply: Avoid loopback workarounds for bounds-approved HTTP forges
egress: Pin the runner's storage writes to the results service's accounts
check: Let the bounds add protected paths as globs
policy: Hold runs off GitHub to a neutral safe-output profile
session: Avoid competing for released test ports
ci: Avoid queue failures from lagging job timestamps
run: Front the broker with run's own proxy, so the agent never holds the run token
collect: Validate and sanitize safe outputs in Rust for callers off GitHub
policy: Admit plain-HTTP clone URLs for hosts the bounds name
register: Mask the run token on Forgejo and refuse its debug switch
apply: Publish a checked hand-back to Forgejo
register: Say when the CI system's ID token endpoint, not the broker, is unreachable
